root_cause: googleCallback performs token exchange/email lookup then signs and stores session directly.
fix_implemented: OAuth now verifies state, S256 PKCE, signed Google ID-token issuer/audience/expiry/nonce/verified email, and account/verification/MFA policy before issuing sessions. Credentials and redirect origins must be configured; provider errors are sanitized.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Actual RSA/JWT and handler regressions use local keys and explicit provider/database stubs. Real Google redirect, consent, account linking, provider replay and HTTPS cookie acceptance remain unexecuted; no production OAuth approval.

root_cause: used check precedes bcrypt work and transaction; later token update has no conditional unused predicate.
fix_implemented: A conditional unused/unexpired token claim, password mutation, session deletion and durable access revocation commit together. Losing claims cannot mutate credentials. New recovery tokens are stored as digests; old unexpired hex links remain compatible. A stored digest is never accepted as a bearer.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Actual gateway/Auth/PostgreSQL: one of eight succeeds, seven400; replay denied, old access/refresh denied, winning password works. Email challenge was seeded only in owned test DB; external mail delivery is not verified.

root_cause: MAX numeric suffix+1 outside transaction plus INSERT OR REPLACE/upsert.
fix_implemented: Staff creation uses UUIDs and insert-only SQL; save updates existing identities and preserves creation time. Normalized email uniqueness is enforced in SQLite/PostgreSQL; conflicts return409. Schema initialization rolls back on failure.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Real SQLite and real PostgreSQL concurrency preserve16distinct accounts; duplicate email409 preserves original role. Review legacy normalized-email duplicates before the additive index; no accounts are merged or deleted automatically.

root_cause: Stale allowlist /oauth/google and /oauth/callback differs from registered /login/google and /oauth/google/callback.
fix_implemented: Gateway public methods/paths now match the actual Google initiation and callback. Unconfigured OAuth returns503 from Auth, rather than the stale gateway401.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Live Google acceptance remains part of SEC-001. No dummy client credentials or unvalidated redirects are used.

root_cause: Auth redirects /oauth-callback#accessToken=...; App only reads query access_token and declares no callback route.
fix_implemented: A dedicated callback page consumes the server fragment, removes credentials from history immediately, verifies the session and sends MFA challenges to the existing second-factor page. Query-token intake and unused redirect targets were removed.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Live Google browser flow remains blocked by approved credentials/provider setup. Access tokens still enter browser memory; SEC-003 remains partial. Callback-specific external acceptance is not replaced by ordinary browser login.

root_cause: Static date/price/status row gated by cached entitlements instead of billing invoice query.
fix_implemented: Billing fetches authoritative invoices with loading/error/retry/pagination and loads entitlements on entry. Fixed paid rows and fake download alerts were removed. Plan access never creates a receipt; paid provider invoices, pending payments and failures have distinct labels.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Actual pro override with zero invoice rows renders zero financial records and correct cold plan state. No synthetic paid invoice is used as provider acceptance. Real checkout/webhook/paid invoice download/refund requires approved test-provider credentials.

root_cause: users.getProfile/updateProfile omit twoFactorEnabled; ProfileIdentityCard replaces auth user; security card coerces omitted field false.
fix_implemented: Profile read/save normalization retains backend MFA state. The identity card applies the complete authoritative saved profile.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Actual TOTP enrollment followed by browser profile/reload shows the disable action. Production HTTPS and external OAuth MFA acceptance remain separate gates.

root_cause: Apply replaces canvasElements, clears customElements/overrides, leaves builtin selectedTemplate; autosave payload omits canvasElements and local persistence strips them.
fix_implemented: Validated session-scoped canvas mode distinguishes literal templates from generated bases. Literal elements/page settings persist through the existing backend canvas API, reload and hydration. Reset/undo/redo retain mode, undo flushes pending saves, and generation preserves literal presentation.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Actual Apply -> backend save -> same-session reload passes. Legacy layouts default to template mode; original lost snapshots cannot be reconstructed. Literal templates stay literal; production PDF sandbox acceptance remains blocked.

root_cause: API wrappers consume access token; frontend has no refresh call; backend refresh exists.
fix_implemented: Server-set refresh cookies are HttpOnly, same-site and Secure in production. Browser requests include credentials and coalesce one renewal; PostgreSQL rotates refresh sessions conditionally. Cookie refresh requires the configured Origin. Logout sends JSON, clears the cookie and cannot silently succeed on a failed server request. Guests clear earlier refresh cookies.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Actual origin rejection, cookie rotation, browser reload renewal and logout/no automatic reauthentication pass. Native tests use HTTP; target TLS/Secure attributes and multi-tab races still require staging acceptance. Legacy bearer clients remain compatible.

root_cause: Legacy admin payment/templates create and document layout/content wrappers remain after integration changes.
fix_implemented: Removed four unused wrappers for nonexistent routes; active canvas/template APIs remain.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Static import review and builds; no assertion that every remaining API action is integrated.

root_cause: except Exception returns {error:str(e)} instead of typed non-success response.
fix_implemented: Reporting query failures return bounded503 messages, not HTTP200 exception payloads. Affected admin breakdown consumers propagate unavailable errors instead of empty success.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Query/transport failure tests are isolated with explicit fault injection. Existing unrelated dashboard fallback semantics are not universally certified.

root_cause: adminListSubscriptions hardcodes currency USD and amount plan.priceMonthly.
fix_implemented: Subscription responses use persisted amount/currency/cadence, never current catalog monthly price or guessed USD. Unknown billing facts remain null. Admin tables display cadence and remove dollar/currency guesses from invoice views.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: USD/LKR minor-unit mapping is regression-tested with explicit synthetic inputs, not represented as paid-provider acceptance. Legacy unknown or unsupported currency facts are not guessed; reconciliation is required.

root_cause: Purge anonymizes Auth and document.userEmail only; no chat/content/PDF purge in current route.
fix_implemented: No destructive purge or invented retention policy was introduced. The cross-store privacy/retention gap remains.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Operator/product retention decisions and resumable complete export/deletion across chats, documents/assets and billing retention are required. Do not advertise complete erasure from the current partial purge.

root_cause: client setCookieToken uses SameSite=Lax only and mirrors token to localStorage.
fix_implemented: Refresh credentials are HttpOnly and the access cookie gains Secure on HTTPS. Callback credentials are removed from history and renewals use Origin validation.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Access tokens remain JavaScript-readable in localStorage/cookies. A complete HttpOnly session/BFF and XSS/CSRF architecture decision plus production TLS/browser verification remains; no XSS exploit or comprehensive security pass is claimed.

root_cause: Demo branches are ordinary application code rather than explicitly gated build targets.
fix_implemented: Demo identity, token and quota branches are limited to development builds. Production asset scans reject their known sentinels.
regression_tests: env NODE_ENV=production npm run build --prefix user-frontend
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Native fixtures now explicitly build frontends with NODE_ENV=production. Demo helpers remain available in development; this never constituted a backend JWT bypass.

root_cause: Controller backup occurs before rollout; timer only monitors; off-host retention is an operator instruction.
fix_implemented: Added an opt-in hourly encrypted off-host restic snapshot job with separate private repository/password/credential files, deployment lock, original key/config inclusion and bounded writer maintenance. It does not initialize repositories, rotate keys, prune or restore production data.
remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Actual native73-table snapshot restore passes. Restic, private remote policy/credentials, retention/immutability, maintenance-window approval, encrypted upload and full-host/key/asset restore are not accepted. Timer was not installed. No RPO/RTO achievement is claimed.

root_cause: Local JSON timer and private metrics have no external heartbeat/page integration.

remaining_risks_and_dependencies: Delivery tests use explicit transport stubs. Operator endpoint/check timeout/notification ownership, disk-exhaustion/whole-host-loss alerts and actual alert receipt remain unconfigured/unexecuted.
